A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' had a [[Twin/Legends|twin]] [[Gender/Legends|brother]] named [[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]], who was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]],<ref name="Lieutenant Sheckil card" /> an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Concord Dawn system/Legends|Concord Dawn system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Fett">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[occupation of Bespin]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' confirms that [[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]] was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] occupation and that his [[Twin/Legends|twin]] was a famous [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] by that [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> the individual became a famous [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] while Sheckil became a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Lieutenant Sheckil card" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sheckil's twin was first referenced on the "Lieutenant Sheckil" card from the [[1997]] ''[[Cloud City Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. The card mentioned Sheckil being from Concord Dawn and being a famous mercenary's twin,<ref name="Lieutenant Sheckil card" /> while likewise actor [[Jeremy Bulloch]] had played both Sheckil and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Prior to the card set's release, Boba Fett was established to have been from Concord Dawn as well in the [[1996]] short story "[[The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett]]," which was published in the ''[[Tales of the Bounty Hunters]]'' anthology.<ref name="Fett" /> However, any possibility of Sheckil's twin being Boba Fett was trumped by the release of the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which established Fett as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] created on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>
